name: Intake
description: Turns what people say about their work into the statements a baseline rests on: each a claim from a source, tagged as a goal, a blocker, a time sink, a handover, a tool or a rule. A model takes them out of pasted notes, or of a chat a stakeholder is invited to by link, or they are typed in. Statements are reviewed and edited before they are saved, in the App's own store, which only its builders reach.
